All.name: Fire
All.basicMagic: After you cast a fire spell you may increase the amount of damage dice dealt by the spell by one. You take that much damage as Vital damage.
All.aura: Increase the damage dice to d8s
All.infusion: You have resistance equal to your level to fire damage and ignore environmental effects based on fire, smoke and heat
All.elementalization:
You are immune to fire damage. 
Your unarmed melee attacks deal an additional d6 of fire damage
You take a d6 of vital damage if you start your turn with the wet condition, or 2d6 if you are underwater

All.name: Water
All.basicMagic: After you cast an water spell you may walk on water and ignore difficult terrain from ice and snow for the rest of the turn
All.aura: Also gain the same resistance to fire
All.infusion: You have a swim speed equal to you land speed. You have a +3 bonus to Athletics, Acrobatics and Brawling checks underwater
All.elementalization:
You can breathe underwater and are unaffected by deep sea pressure. 
You ignore difficult terrain for snow, ice, and checks to balance on them.
You can hide underwater without objects to hide behind and have +3 bonus to Stealth checks underwater

All.name: Earth
All.basicMagic: After you cast an earth spell you have a +3 bonus to saving throws against being knocked prone, off-guard or moved against your will until the start of your next turn
All.aura: Also gain half that resistance to physical damage
All.infusion: You have resistance equal to a third of your level to physical damage.
All.elementalization:
You have a burrow speed of 3. 
Your resistance increases to half your level

All.name: Air
All.basicMagic: After you cast an air spell you ignore difficult terrain for the rest of the turn
All.aura: Gain a +1 bonus to reflex saving throws against ranged attacks
All.infusion: When you jump the distance and height you can jump is doubled. You treat difficult terrain from harsh winds as one step less.
All.elementalization: You have a fly speed (hover) of 5

All.name: Metal
All.basicMagic: After you cast an metal spell you gain resistance 3 to physical damage until the start of your next turn
All.aura: Gain a +1 bonus to reflex saving throws against attacks with metal weapons or spells/abilities with the metal trait
All.infusion: You can use your reaction to create a spot of metal on your body, giving you resistance equal to your level against an attack

All.name: Lightning
All.basicMagic: After you cast a lightning spell you deal 1d6 lightning damage to the first creature that hits you with a melee attack until the start of the next turn
All.aura: You can spend a focus point to increase the range of the damaging aura to 3 tiles for the turn
All.infusion: You have resistance equal to your level to lightning damage. You can choose to add 1d4 lightning damage on unarmed strikes and melee attacks with metal weapons. When you succeed on grapple check you can deal 1d6 lightning  damage
All.elementalization:
Increase your movespeed by 1. 
When you Step you move one more tile.

All.name: Light
All.basicMagic: After you cast an light spell you may emit bright light in a radius of 2 + the spells rank until the start of the next turn
All.aura: Your aura emits bright light for 4 tiles, and dim light for 4 more
All.infusion: You emit bright light for 2 tiles, and dim light for 2 more. You can toggle this as an action
All.elementalization:
You cannot be blinded or dazzled. 
The range of your light is doubled and you can choose to emit as a cone or line instead

All.name: Darkness
All.basicMagic: After you cast an darkness spell, you gain darkvision until the start of your next turn
All.aura: Creatures that fail their saving throw are blinded next turn unless they take an action to blink
All.infusion: You gain darkvision. You have a +3 bonus to visual stealth checks
All.elementalization:
Once per turn you can spend an action to emit a cloud of magical darkness covering adjoining four tiles starting from you. 
You have +1 movespeed and a +1 bonus to all D20 rolls while in darkness
